channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Minimally Invasive Performance Tweaks
item.description: Client-side performance mod that should not break other mods.

item.title: Advanced Tool Parts
item.description: Add handles and bindings to your tools to make them faster and last longer!

item.title: Vintage Przygoda: Korony
item.description: Mod serwera Vintage Przygoda: Korony. Potrzebny tylko do gry na tym serwerze.

item.title: ServerSideModRemover
item.description: removes all blocks in a radius of the player. The blocks are defined by the ModID

item.title: eViSTool — Linux
item.description: Mod manager and dedicated server tool: updates, rollback, ModDB catalog, backups, remote control

item.title: eViSTool — Windows
item.description: Mod manager and dedicated server tool: updates, rollback, ModDB catalog, backups, remote control

item.description: Makes the smith load-bearing: every metal tool needs a seasoned haft and a forged rivet.

item.title: Null Skills
item.description: A maintained fork of XLib and XSkills for 1.22: thirteen skill trees, 185 abilities.

item.title: Ponder

item.description: Remembers where you have been and draws it onto your Frontier's Map, a little more each visit.

item.description: Mod that changes the game's combat mechanics: adds weapons with combo attacks, weapon blocking syste

item.description: Host your world for friends, comes with an island hub, cosmetics, emotes, and chat.

item.title: AdvancedGeology + W. Geology Compat
item.description: Advanced Geology + Wilderlands Geology compatibility patch

item.title: Teapot's Undead Legion
item.description: Armed undead Revenants roam the night. Bind your own with a Temporal Core and lead them to battle!

item.description: adds the rabbit from the film "Monty Python and the Holy Grail" a rare easteregg mob in the game

item.title: For Days to Come - Modpack
item.description: A vanilla+ modpack for immersive survival, exploration, and medieval life.

item.title: Galeret Traits Mod
item.description: A simple mod to add Trais to my Galeret race Mod

item.title: Threnkal
item.description: A race of cow folks based on minotaurs and taurens from WoW.

item.title: Panning Machine
item.description: Simple machine for panning, now with a heavy-duty Industrial Panning Machine ⚙️

item.description: Makes bears climb wooden blocks and branchy leaves, and path up trees after you

item.description: Compatibility and customization pack for the Evenfall server

item.title: racialnpcs
item.description: allows npcs of multiple races to be created

item.description: Hardcore navigation: no world map, no coordinate readouts, and the server-side leaks closed too.

item.description: Four compasses and a temporal beacon that can be attuned. Bearings, never positions.

item.description: Land claiming without commands: one hotkey opens a window that drives vanilla's own claim system.
